title: Yellowed Buttery Middle Eastern Puff Pastry Umm Ali
description: A malty, light, and comforting Middle Eastern dessert featuring puff pastry, sake cooking, and poaching, served in a lazy susan spinner vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut the pastry into 6 equal pieces and place them in a lazy susan spinner vessel.
In a saucepan, combine the sake, milk, sugar, and melted butter, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs and rose water.
Pour the egg mixture over the pastry pieces in the vessel.
Sprinkle the chopped pistachios over the top of the pastry.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
